Name: Moss Covered Tree Recolor
Author: Croebh
Description:
I was almost into Summer into my first playthrough in the 1.6 version of the game, before I saw my partner hit a tree with their sword and get moss. I genuinely couldn't tell the moss covered trees from the other trees!

With some guidance, I found I was able to notice the difference in pine trees, but even then I was struggling.

This is a very quick texture pack to adjust the levels/colours of all the moss covered tree variants, helping make it a lot more obvious when a tree is covered.
